zh-CN.title: 聊天禁言管理
items: 群主和空间运营现在可以按时长禁言群成员，群内会同步显示系统消息
空间管理员可以设置全局聊天禁言，成员会收到官方私聊通知

en.title: Chat mute controls
items: Group owners and space operators can now mute members for a selected duration with an in-chat system notice
Space administrators can apply a global chat mute and notify the member through an official direct message
